name: SDN Provider Latest Dataset Flow
description: HTTP provider-scoped latest-dataset flow (gateway loop G.4): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route discover emits the routing decision (latest_dataset with peerId + standard | not_found), hostcap/p2p-discovery latest_dataset issues the policy-mediated p2p.latest_dataset hostcall (the provider's newest signature-attributed publication batch when the host's OPT-IN gateway.pin covers the pair — or the peer is the node itself — AND the batch's shard content is fully materialized locally; stream delivery is a host body reference except on the json path), foundation/discovery-shape shape_latest turns the materials into the response decision (200 batch stream verbatim / body-reference descriptor; format=json routes the raw $OMM stream through foundation/omm-json for the bare-array presentation, non-OMM standards answer 406; unknown provider/standard answers an honest 404; known-but-unpinned or not-yet-materialized answers 503 with the newest signed-PNM pointer in the body — NO silent proxy fetch), and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404/406/503) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossing is the declared p2p_read hostcall.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Provider-scoped dataset retrieval (gateway loop G.4): any node serves any provider's newest published dataset it has OPT-IN pinned (gateway.pin), plus its own publications.

routes.summary: Provider's newest published dataset for a standard
routes.description: The newest dataset publication BATCH the provider peer published for the standard (e.g. celestrak.eth × OMM) — the exact shard content its signed PNM points to, served verbatim from this node's local materialization and re-verified against the recorded SHA-256 on every materialization. SERVING IS OPT-IN: the node answers 200 only when its gateway.pin config pins the (peer, standard) pair (or the peer is the node itself); each new publication SUPERSEDES the previous pin (the superseded batch's records are evicted, not accumulated). Publication batches are content deltas: a batch carries the records first seen in it, which for OMM full-catalog cycles is effectively the whole catalog. HONEST UNAVAILABILITY: an unknown provider/standard answers 404; a dataset known via signed PNM but not pinned here (pinning is never a default) or not yet materialized answers 503 with the newest PNM pointer object ({CID, FILE_ID, PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP, batch_id, standard, schema, signature_verified, attribution} — PNM schema fields schema-exact, synthesized fields lowercase) in the body so the client can fetch the publication itself over p2p — this gateway NEVER silently proxy-fetches. format=json is a presentation adapter available for OMM (bare top-level array via foundation/omm-json); other standards answer 406 and serve the flatbuffer stream only.

params.name: peerId
params.description: libp2p peer ID of the PUBLISHING provider (e.g. 16Uiu2HAm…).

params.name: standard
params.description: Space-data standard name (omm, cat, spw, …), case-insensitive.

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = the aligned size-prefixed record stream of the published batch, VERBATIM (default). json = bare JSON array presentation (OMM only; other standards answer 406).

200.description: The newest fully-materialized publication batch, exactly as published. Metadata rides in headers on BOTH encodings: X-SDN-Record-Count and a content-derived ETag shared across encodings.

application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream.description: Aligned size-prefixed FlatBuffer frames of the standard's record type — the published shard content spliced in window order, byte-verbatim.

application/json.description: Bare top-level JSON array of records (format=json, OMM only).

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the stream ETag). Empty body, ETag header repeated.

404.description: Provider/standard unknown to this node: no signature-attributable publication exists here.

406.description: format=json requested for a standard without a JSON presentation adapter (v1 ships OMM only); use the flatbuffer stream.

503.description: Known via signed PNM but not served here: the (peer, standard) pair is not in this node's opt-in gateway.pin, or the pinned batch is not fully materialized yet. Body: {"error": …, "pnm": {CID, FILE_ID, PUBLISH_TIMESTAMP, batch_id, standard, schema, signature_verified, attribution}} (PNM schema fields schema-exact, synthesized fields lowercase — hard rule json-schema-capitalization-rule) — fetch the publication directly via the pointer; this gateway never silently proxies.
